title: Safety Signals Detected for Multiple Vaccines for Infants
content: Introduction: Safety signals were detected for infants age 0 for epilepsy, bradycardia, and cardiac arrest adverse events (AEs) for specific vaccines and vaccine combinations.  From these observations, additional elevated infant age 0 AEs safety signals are suspected.  This study examines additional AEs examining elevated infant age 0 AEs safety signals to provide etiology insights.  Methods: Herein, Vaccine Adverse Events Reporting System (VAERS) was retrospectively examined for candidate AEs for infants age 0.  Results: Additional safety signals were identified for 14 additional AEs affecting infant neurological, cardiovascular, gastrointestinal systems, and mortality.  Safety signals were detected for specific vaccines and specific concomitantly administered vaccines; specific safety signals were associated with live attenuated vaccines. Concomitant administration of specific vaccine combinations is associated with elevated risk levels for one or more AEs.  Conclusions:  Specific vaccines and concomitant vaccine combinations are resulting in infant AEs consistent with dosage levels being too high.  In addition, development of alternative (non-live) rotavirus vaccine is suggested.  Lack of dosage adjustment based on child weight/age is likely a major causative factor.
